Filled by ecl::markers::AvailabilitySystem::ProcessAvailablePortals (EoCClient.dll+0x7B9150, not read). macOS default constructor: three zeroed 16-byte blocks; live (idle): all zero = empty set. Guids are navigation portal (waypoint) ids.
